description.value: The Keg Steakhouse + Bar at Park Royal is a Canadian steakhouse chain located on the south side of Park Royal Mall in West Vancouver, known for aged beef, a full bar, and a covered heated patio. The location is wheelchair accessible and includes a semi-private dining room suitable for groups. Takeout and DoorDash delivery are available for those who want a meal on the go.
